reapack.name: Volca Drum Panel.jsfx
reapack.desc: Volca Drum Panel (Korg volca drum editor)

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Select split into SRC / MOD.T / EG.T rows. Two looks (Classic / Sleeve) + 14 color themes. Test hit and Q (pitch quantize, CC 53) per part. Tooltips. Notes on channel 11-16 play parts melodically. FILT locked for ROLL by default.

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Classic look: part titles = small PART label + big number, so they fit at any window size (were cut to "P...").

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Fix: switching Q (pitch quantize) off now always brings the part back to its PITCH value (also via undo / automation).

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Works together with the new Volca Drum Sequencer (p-locks, kit per pattern, LINK sends locks to both layers). AUTO SEND: the whole kit goes out once after a project load (toggle next to SEND ALL, on by default). Sound files: SAVE / LOAD / RENAME / DELETE a part in the SOUND menu (save, rename, delete need the action "Volca listener (start)"). Kit actions: Volca kit (save) / (kit +) / (kit -) / (send all), kit names in the display. UNDO also takes back a kit load and MORPH. Sends are paced by time. Fixes: typed values time out, locks after a sample-rate change, sound names starting with # ! > <. Installs the scripts too (Actions list: "Volca ...").

reapack.desc: Volca Drum Sequencer (step sequencer for the Korg volca drum)
